testcase.name: promptCaching=true should honor explicit system cache marker
promptCaching=true without system should add cache_control to last tool
promptCaching=true should disable system cache when disabled marker exists
multiple system messages preserve order and cache markers
promptCaching=false should not add cache_control anywhere
promptCaching=true with only one user message should not add cache_control to messages
promptCaching=true should not cache unmarked system block but should cache last tool
promptCaching=true should add cache_control to second-to-last real user message
